as_told.title: Detlev Bronk's alien autopsies after the Aztec and Roswell crashes
as_told.place_text: Aztec, New Mexico; Roswell, New Mexico

plain: A scientist named Detlev Bronk, who later ran the Rockefeller Foundation and was president of Johns Hopkins University, was in charge of what were called alien autopsies, Michels says. In one episode he says this with no source. In another he cites the Majestic 12 documents, papers said to describe a secret group of officials who handled crashed UFOs, and says the bodies came from a claimed crash at a place called Aztec and maybe from the 1947 Roswell case. If true, it would put a leading figure of American science at the center of studying alien bodies.
